87983.commentary: (APAa) yaṃnūn'āhaṃ pañcasīlaṃ rakkheyyaṃ paripūrayan'ti pañcasīlaṃ samādiyitvā paripūrento yaṃnūna rakkheyyaṃ sādhukaṃ bhaddakaṃ sundaraṃ katvā paripāleyyan'ti attho.

examples.text: deyyadhammo ca me n'atthi, varāko bhatako ahaṃ, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ pañcasīlaṃ, rakkheyyaṃ paripūrayaṃ.
kiṃ pana me tvaṃ, pāpima, passasi yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadesi, kāretu, bhante, bhagavā rajjaṃ, kāretu sugato, rajjaṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā'ti?

87985.meaningLit: discourse on this is mine, etc.

examples.text: evaṃ jarā ca maccu ca, adhivattanti pāṇine, khattiye brāhmaṇe vesse, sudde caṇḍālapukkuse, na kiñci parivajjeti, sabbam'ev'ābhimaddati.
dhammani [etth'āyaṃ dhammasaddo sakkate dhanvanaṃ-saddena sadiso maruvācako'ti veditabbo, yathā daḷhadhammā'ti-padaṃ].

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idha, bhante, saṅgāravo nāma brāhmaṇo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati udakasuddhiko, udakena suddhiṃ pacceti, sāyaṃ pātaṃ udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.
sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi krubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo'ti.

87990.commentary: (JAa) santo saggaparāyaṇā'ti paṇḍitā pana dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ rakkhitvā uposathakammaṃ karitvā tīṇi sucaritāni pūretvā saggaparāyaṇā honti, mahantaṃ saggasukhasampattiṃ anubhavantī'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ svākkhāte, bhikkhave, mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike yesaṃ mayi saddhāmattaṃ pemamattaṃ sabbe te saggaparāyanā'ti.
tasmā satañ'ca asataṃ, nānā hoti ito gati, asanto nirayaṃ yanti, santo saggaparāyanā.
saddhā hi dānaṃ bahudhā pasatthaṃ, dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ'va seyyo, pubbe ca hi pubbatare ca santo, nibbānam'ev'ajjhagamuṃ sapaññā'ti.
kodhaṃ jahe vippajaheyya mānaṃ, saṃyojanaṃ sabbam'atikkameyya, taṃ nāmarūpasmim'asajjamānaṃ, akiñcanaṃ n'ānupatanti dukkhā.

87995.meaningLit: to cause to make a kingdom

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā'ti?
vessantaraṃ taṃ pucchāmi, sakuṇa bhaddam'atthu te, rajjaṃ kāretu'kāmena, kiṃ su kiccaṃ kataṃ varaṃ.

atha kho rājā ca māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto rājā ca pasenadi kosalo saṅgāmesuṃ. tasmiṃ kho pana saṅgāme rājā pasenadi kosalo rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ parājesi, jīvaggāhañ'ca naṃ aggahesi.
etadeva titikkhāya, vajjaṃ passāmi vāsava, yadā naṃ maññati bālo, bhayā my'āyaṃ titikkhati, ajjhāruhati dummedho, go'va bhiyyo palāyinan'ti.

87998.commentary: (SNa) piṇḍapātena paṭipādesī'ti piṇḍapātena saddhiṃ saṃyojesi, piṇḍapātaṃ adāsī'ti attho.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, mahārāja, evam'etaṃ, mahārāja! bhūtapubbaṃ so, mahārāja, seṭṭhi gahapati taggarasikhiṃ nāma paccekasambuddhaṃ piṇḍapātena paṭipādesi. detha samaṇassa piṇḍan'ti vatvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkāmi.
